newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest spot propane edges down in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest spot propane edges down in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices fell in thin midday trade on Tuesday, with few players available due to the extended Christmas break.
Spot propane in the Midwest trading hub of Conway, Kansas, was talked between 81.00 cents and 82.00 cents a gallon, seven cents lower late trade on Monday.
Mont Belvieu prices, meanwhile, were talked about one cent lower with little activity spotted ahead of the Christmas holiday on Wednesday.
- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1631
